answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 15305 Country: India Title: Assalamu alaikum I have two male childs. First one is named Mohammed Furqan. Second male child was born on 5th july 09. I was planning to keep his name as Imdadullah but my parents have decided to name him Hamdan. Please give me the meaning of hamdan and which name can i choose from both? Question: Assalamu alaikum I have two male childs. First one is named Mohammed Furqan. Second male child was born on 5th july 09. I was planning to keep his name as Imdadullah but my parents have decided to name him Hamdan. Please give me the meaning of hamdan and which name can i choose from both? Answer ID: 15305 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1482/1209=D/1430) Imdadullah also was a good name. However, when he was named Hamdan it was also alright. Hamdan means praiseworthy. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
